# Comparisons

This folder contains comparison articles generated from structured data tables in the 2023 and 2024 ADHD annual reports. The pages track demographic breakdowns of the ADHD assessment and treatment populations and evaluate regional and departmental performance against 11 distinct clinical and educational quality indicators. Topics range from somatic assessments and diagnostic conferences to psychoeducation rates, medication usage, and primary school leaving exam pass rates, highlighting systemic shortfalls against the 90% development targets and significant regional disparities across Denmark.

## Pages

- [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] — Demographic breakdown of the ADHD treatment population by age, gender, and region, highlighting a male dominance and regional volume disparities.
- [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] — Demographic analysis of the ADHD assessment population, showing age and gender distributions and regional assessment volumes.
- [[antal-udredningsforloeb-afsluttet-indenfor-90-dage-pga-mistanke-afkraeftet|Antal udredningsforløb afsluttet indenfor 90 dage pga. mistanke afkræftet]] — Tracks the volume of assessments closed within 90 days due to disproven suspicion, revealing Region Syddanmark as a massive national outlier.
- [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] — Compares regional and facility compliance with the requirement for somatic examinations within 120 days of starting an ADHD assessment.
- [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] — Evaluates the proportion of adult treatment courses where social support needs are assessed within 120 days, showing universal failure to meet the 90% target.
- [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] — Measures the proportion of adult ADHD treatment courses involving pharmacological treatment, highlighting Region Hovedstaden as a significant low-performing outlier.
- [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]] — Tracks the completion of clinical environmental observations for 0–5-year-olds within 120 days, showing stagnant national averages and severe regional disparities.
- [[indikator-2b-andelen-af-udredningsforloeb-blandt-6-17-aarige-hvor-der-senest-120-dage-efter-start-af-adhd-udredning-er-foretaget-enten-manualiseret-diagnostisk-interview-eller-miljoeobservation|"Indikator 2b: Andelen af udredningsforløb blandt 6-17 årige, hvor der, senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning, er foretaget enten manualiseret diagnostisk interview eller miljøobservation"]] — Details the 2023/24 compliance rates for diagnostic interviews or observations in 6–17-year-olds, noting Odense as the sole clinic meeting the standard.
- [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] — Provides updated 2024/25 data on diagnostic interviews and observations for 6–17-year-olds, highlighting widespread non-compliance and private hospital failures.
- [[indikator-3-andelen-af-udredningsforloeb-hvor-der-er-afholdt-diagnostisk-konference-med-deltagelse-af-speciallaege-i-boerne-og-ungdomspsykiatri-senest-120-dage-efter-start-af-adhd-udredning|"Indikator 3: Andelen af udredningsforløb, hvor der er afholdt diagnostisk konference med deltagelse af speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning"]] — Examines historical compliance with the 120-day diagnostic conference requirement, showing systemic failure across all regions.
- [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]] — Compares 2024/25 regional performance on diagnostic conferences, noting a dramatic outlier increase in Region Midtjylland.
- [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] — Tracks the fulfillment of coordinating network meetings within 90 days of treatment start, revealing a systemic failure to meet the 90% target across all regions and departments.
- [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] — Evaluates the initiation of ADHD-related psychoeducation within 120 days for children and adolescents, with BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn as a notable high-performing outlier.
- [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] — Compares the proportion of child and adolescent treatment courses involving ADHD medication, highlighting Region Nordjylland as the consistent national leader.
- [[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]] — Tracks primary school leaving exam pass rates for youth in the ADHD assessment population, revealing a persistent 25–30 percentage point deficit compared to the background population.
- [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]] — Compares school leaving exam pass rates for youth in the ADHD treatment population against the general benchmark, showing a wide and persistent achievement gap.
- [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] — Measures the initiation of psychoeducation within 120 days for adult ADHD treatment courses, showing universal non-compliance with the 90% target.
- [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] — Evaluates the provision of psychotherapy within a year for adult patients where it was deemed relevant, recording a mere 1% national fulfillment rate.
- [[indikatoroversigt|Indikatoroversigt]] — Defines the 13 distinct quality indicators for ADHD assessment and treatment, outlining their types, formats, and development targets.
- [[oversigt-over-de-samlede-indikatorresultater|Oversigt over de samlede indikatorresultater]] — Synthesizes the overall performance across all 13 indicators over three reporting periods, highlighting systemic target failures and declining educational outcomes.
